messages:
maya: FYI ran HF->Redwood convert for ft-llama-small. Streaming outputs often stop early when tokenizer has multiple EOS aliases ("</s>", "<|eos|>"). Paste of the small config + observed behavior below.

maya: config.json snippet:
```
{
  "eos_token": "</s>",
  "special_tokens_map": {"eos_token": "</s>", "additional_special_tokens": ["<|eos|>", "<|pad|>"]},
  "eos_token_id": null
}
```

samir: can you paste tokenizer.json or `tokenizer.special_tokens_map`? suspect both tokens map to different ids.

maya: tokenizer.special_tokens_map:
```
{"eos_token": "</s>", "additional_special_tokens": ["<|eos|>"]}
# tokenizer.convert_tokens_to_ids('</s>') -> 1
# tokenizer.convert_tokens_to_ids('<|eos|>') -> 50256
```

tina: saw similar when we quantized and enabled streaming. runtime logs:
```
INFO streaming: chunk 0 -> 'Hello world'
INFO streaming: stop seq matched token id=1 ('</s>')
INFO streaming: closing stream early
```
but the model emits '<|eos|>' right after; because EOS id mismatch, streaming code flags early stop on first alias.

eli: actionable: during HF->Redwood conversion we should canonicalize special tokens mapping: pick one canonical eos token id and merge aliases in `vocab.json` mapping and set `eos_token_id` to canonical id in model config. e.g.
```
# in convert script
aliases = ['</s>', '<|eos|>']
canonical = aliases[0]
for a in aliases:
  mapping[a] = mapping[canonical]
config['eos_token'] = canonical
config['eos_token_id'] = mapping[canonical]
```

samir: also add a streaming test that injects both token byte sequences and checks stop detection for alias ids.

maya: I ran a quick patch -> PR coming. Quick diff: set eos_token_id=1 and add token alias linking; after patch streaming produced full text and ended only when canonical eos emitted.

maya: repro prompt used:
```
"Write a short poem. <|eos|>"
```
before patch truncated after first newline.

tina: note: quantized kernels sometimes merge token ids differently; add quantization-only test matrix.

eli: filing issue #342 and assign to @maya. Add unit tests for: (1) alias mapping, (2) streaming stop detection across ids, (3) quantized path.

maya: will open PR + tests today. thanks all :thumbsup:
